title: Golden Hour, Timelapse and the Tools hub
lede: Two local tools audited end to end and ported into the site as /golden-hour and /timelapse, plus a /tools hub. Golden Hour answers "when is the light good at this venue, in its local time"; Timelapse answers "what do I dial in, and how long do I roll" for the team's actual bodies.

stats.k: venues with real time zones (4 UW + 17 Big Ten)
camera bodies, 3 methods, limits from Sony Help Guides
new tests: routing, headers, CSP, hashes, maths

sections.heading: Golden Hour
sections.note: Same fixed clock (Sep 24, 6:35 PM CDT, inside evening golden hour), same viewport, empty storage, location not granted. Top-of-page viewport captures; full pages are further down.

pairs.title: Phone, during evening golden hour
pairs.beforeCap: No location shown up top; date is a raw 09/24/2026 field; golden hour ends at sunset (6:53).
pairs.afterCap: Venue picker first, readable date, photographer convention: golden runs to 7:11 (−4°), 36m left.

pairs.title: Desktop
pairs.beforeCap: Theme switch takes the header; no way back to other tools.
pairs.afterCap: Shared tools chrome with a link to the hub; blue hour sits inside each window's card.

pairs.title: Changing location
pairs.sub: Before: tap Change. After: pick UCLA.
pairs.beforeCap: Raw latitude/longitude boxes, and times always on the device clock, so a road venue reads wrong.
pairs.afterCap: Pick a venue; times switch to PDT and say so. The interaction differs by design.

sections.heading: Timelapse
sections.note: Same clock and viewport, empty storage. The stills scenario is the old “α · interval shooting” vs the new A7 V → Interval, both in clip-length mode with a 20 s clip and a 30 min window.

pairs.title: Phone, first open
pairs.beforeCap: Two hard-coded rigs; default plan made a 4-minute clip.
pairs.afterCap: Camera picker plus the methods that body really has; default is a usable 20 s clip.

pairs.title: Desktop, first open
pairs.afterCap: Roll time now takes seconds, which short S&Q rolls need.

pairs.title: Stills, find the setting
pairs.sub: 20 s clip from a 30 min window
pairs.beforeCap: Worked here by luck (3 s); other windows produced fractional intervals the camera can't set.
pairs.afterCap: Snaps to whole seconds and states the exact roll; body-specific file size (A7 V compressed RAW ≈ 35 MB).

sections.heading: New surfaces and full pages (after only)
sections.note: No baseline exists for the hub, dark mode checks, or the Time-lapse method; these are after-only.

changes.was: Golden Hour used only the device clock. Planning a UCLA or Rutgers shoot from Madison gave times 1–2 hours off, with only a warning.
changes.now: 21 venues carry IANA time zones; times, 'today', midnight bounds and DST are computed in the venue's zone. GPS and typed coordinates still use the device clock.

changes.h: Geolocation was blocked on the site
changes.was: The site-wide Permissions-Policy: geolocation=() would have silently broken “Use my location”.
changes.now: /golden-hour/* alone gets geolocation=(self); every other route is unchanged. Verified on a local Next server.

changes.was: Golden = −0.833° to 6°, blue = all of civil twilight.
changes.now: Photographer convention: golden +6° to −4°, blue −4° to −6°, sunrise/sunset shown for reference.

changes.h: Stale page after midnight; null in copied text
changes.was: A page left open past midnight stopped updating; copying on a day without a 6° crossing printed null.
changes.now: Follows today while you're on today; copy text handles every case and names the zone.

changes.was: “FX3 video vs α stills”, with 24/33/61 MP sizes, flat bitrates and no in-camera Time-lapse.
changes.now: FX3, A1, A1 II, A7 V, A9 III. S&Q on all, interval stills on all (FX3 included), Time-lapse movie on A7 V/A1 II/A9 III with the 5 s 4K cap. Bitrates per record frame rate and file sizes per body, from Sony's guides.

changes.h: “Find the setting” produced settings you can't dial in
changes.was: Fractional stills intervals and off-list S&Q rates, with shot counts that didn't match the menu card.
changes.now: Snaps to real settings and gives the exact roll that yields the requested clip, plus what your full window would give.

notes: Sony doesn't publish RAW/JPEG sizes; card figures are derived from each body's recordable-images table and labelled approximate.
Time-lapse recording limits (≈120 min; A9 III 4K ≈60 min) are Sony's approximate figures, surfaced as a warning only.
QR Studio has no link back to /tools yet; its page is generated from the Work Projects source, so that change belongs there.
